name: codex-advisor
description: Double-check layer for the Official Codex plugin — wraps every Codex interaction with Claude's independent critical evaluation. Skills: setup, review, adversarial, rescue, verify, research, status, result, cancel. Task delegation (rescue) wraps your verbatim request in adaptive, preview-approved prompt blocks. Every skill accepts --model/--effort via config.toml. Tested against codex@openai-codex 1.0.4 and Codex CLI 0.125 (gpt-5.5).
